purpose: MCC-owned external Composer scenarios submit a typed step plan; MCD owns admission, command construction, backup, receipt and rollback.

request.unknown_fields: rejected at top level and in patch_plan, backup, evidence and step objects; no forward-compatible silent dropping

binding.root: absolute canonical Mautic root; never instance@host

steps.order: composer_json_update -> composer_update -> pre-cache patch phases -> cache_clear -> post-cache patch phases -> mautic_finish -> doctrine_migrate -> verify

patch_plan.phases: must exactly equal the patch_phase entries in steps; when empty, plan_file/plan_sha256/run_id are empty
patch_plan.plan_file: absolute private root-owned MCD plan file, only required when phases are non-empty
patch_plan.plan_sha256: lowercase SHA-256 of the canonical immutable patch plan

backup.policy: MCD creates the immutable pre-mutation archive; caller cannot select its path or bytes

request.cron_policy: must be unchanged; the MCD scheduler fence/pause/drain owns maintenance

fixed_primitives.composer_json_update: MCD performs the bounded source_version -> target_version replacement and target constraint normalization
fixed_primitives.composer_update: www-data Composer update --with-dependencies with MCD-deferred Composer scripts
fixed_primitives.cache_clear: MCD production-cache clear with its existing fallback
fixed_primitives.doctrine_migrate: MCD-discovered Doctrine migration command with --no-interaction and reconciliation
fixed_primitives.verify: exact target version plus required MCD post-upgrade HTTP/permission checks

maintenance.before: exclusive MCD dispatch fence, scheduler pause and task drain
maintenance.during: the same fence remains held by the single executor process
maintenance.after: scheduler restoration is observed before success receipt; system cron is unchanged

receipt.durability: MCD writes the terminal receipt atomically before returning; repeated run_id returns the same terminal receipt without re-executing

failure.mutation_started: restore the MCD-owned archive and report rollback state
failure.unknown_state: never report success; rollback_failed or error remains terminal
